Place & perspective

Two cities. Distinct visual identities.

The UAE portfolio brings Dubai and Abu Dhabi into one collection while keeping the individual character of each property visible. The cities’ architectural variety provides context; the selected photographs show the specific work. A useful brief connects that context to the story a brand wants to tell.

01

Dubai photography, from character to detail

The Dubai selection includes 25 Hours Dubai, Raffles The Palm, Rixos The Palm, Rixos JBR and Th8 Palm Dubai. Together, these galleries provide different references for hotel and interior photography in Dubai. Look at how the images work as a collection, then describe the architectural features, spaces and atmosphere that matter to your own project.

02

Abu Dhabi photography and the Saadiyat reference

Rixos Premium Saadiyat is the Abu Dhabi project currently represented here. Its gallery gives a specific starting point for discussing a photography commission in the city. Architecture, shared spaces and smaller details can be considered together when defining the purpose and intended use of a new collection.

03

Planning a UAE photography commission

For a Dubai or Abu Dhabi enquiry, provide the exact location, preferred dates, access arrangements and a priority shot list. Include the formats and channels you expect to use. Charlot Crea works internationally from Türkiye; travel, scope and delivery are planned around the selected sites and the needs of the project.
